_comment: Holdout validation for opt1hyear-results. Takes the top-N configs per coin from the live 1h leaderboard (ranked by score DESC, exactly as `opt1hyear-results <coin> best` does) and replays each one over history the optimizer NEVER saw: from the coin's first bar up to 2025-07-19, the day before the optimizer's window opens.
_sizing: FIXED $1000 notional per trade (qty_pct_equity forced to 0). The live tree uses 100%-of-equity compounding, which inflates net% and makes drawdown incomparable across coins. Numbers here will be far smaller than the leaderboard's and that is the point.
